title: Naturality of sections on an etale object under base change
statement: Let $R$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on $R_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $W\to R$ an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For any $f:X\to R$ set $V_f=W\times_R X$ [def-pc-fibre-product], $v_f=\operatorname{pr}_W:V_f\to W\to R$, and $F_f=v_f^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Define $e_f:(f_*f^{-1}G)(W)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(V_f,F_f)$ as follows: direct image evaluates as $(f^{-1}G)(V_f)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]; restriction along the etale projection $V_f\to X$ identifies this with global sections of its inverse image; compose with the inverse-image composition isomorphism for $v_f=\operatorname{pr}_X\,f$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction, lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. This additive equivalence is the explicitly defined pullbackSectionsEquiv. For $h:X\to Y$, $f:Y\to R$, $g:X\to R$ with $g=hf$, let $m:V_g\to V_f$ satisfy $\operatorname{pr}_W m=\operatorname{pr}_W$ and $\operatorname{pr}_Y m=h\operatorname{pr}_X$. Let $\rho:(f_*f^{-1}G)(W)\to(g_*g^{-1}G)(W)$ be the map obtained from the unit of $h^{-1}\dashv h_*$ and the composition isomorphisms of direct and inverse image. Let $\sigma:\Gamma(V_f,F_f)\to\Gamma(V_g,F_g)$ be pullback on global sections along $m$ followed by the inverse-image composition isomorphism for $v_g=mv_f$. Then $e_g\rho=\sigma e_f$. No compactness, separation, or inverse-limit hypothesis is imposed.

Evaluate the resulting equality of additive-group morphisms at s.

theorem pullbackSections_comparison (R : Scheme.{u})
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (W : R.Etale) :
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let v := fun {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ R) ↦ pullback.fst W.hom f ≫ W.hom
    let F := fun {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ R) ↦ (upperStar A (v f)).obj G
    let e := fun {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ R) ↦ pullbackSectionsEquiv G W f
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ R) (g : X ⟶ R)
        (w : g = h ≫ f) (m : pullback W.hom g ⟶ pullback W.hom f)
        (hm : m ≫ pullback.fst W.hom f = pullback.fst W.hom g)
        (hm' : m ≫ pullback.snd W.hom f = pullback.snd W.hom g ≫ h)
        (s : ((lowerStar A f).obj ((upperStar A f).obj G)).obj.obj (op W)),
        e g (((lowerStar A f).map
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A h).unit.app ((upperStar A f).obj G)) ≫
          (lowerStarComp A h f g w).hom.app _ ≫
          (lowerStar A g).map ((upperStarComp A h f g w).inv.app G)).hom.app (op W) s) =
        (globalSectionsUpperStarMap A m (F f) ≫
          (Sheaf.Γ (pullback W.hom g).smallEtaleTopology A).map
            ((upperStarComp A m (v f) (v g)
              (by dsimp [v]; rw [← Category.assoc, hm])).inv.app G)) (e f s)
